intro: 含两个独立储能元件（一个 L、一个 C）的电路由二阶微分方程描述。解题的套路始终是：**列方程 → 特征根判阻尼 → 写出通解形式 → 用 0₊ 时刻的两个初始条件定常数**。第二个初始条件（导数）最容易出错。

en.intro: A circuit with two independent energy-storage elements (one L, one C) is described by a second-order differential equation. The routine is always: **write the equation → characteristic roots decide the damping → write the form of the solution → fix the constants with two initial conditions at 0+**. The second initial condition (the derivative) is where most mistakes happen.

ideas.title: 列二阶微分方程与特征方程
text: 以 v_C（或 i_L）为变量，用 KCL、KVL 和元件 VCR 消去其他量。RLC 串联电路（i 与 v_C 关联，i = C dv_C/dt）：LC v_C″ + RC v_C′ + v_C = v_s。
把 v_C = Ae^{st} 代入齐次方程得到**特征方程** LCs² + RCs + 1 = 0，即 s² + (R/L)s + 1/(LC) = 0。特征根只取决于 t > 0 的电路结构和参数，与激励、初始值无关。
电路不是简单串联或并联时（例如电感串接 RC 并联），同样先在结点列 KCL、在回路列 KVL，再代入消元；特征方程的系数要从这一步得出，不能套串联公式。

en.title: The second-order equation and its characteristic equation
text: Take v_C (or i_L) as the unknown and eliminate the other quantities with KCL, KVL and the element VCRs. For a series RLC circuit (i and v_C in the passive sign convention, i = C dv_C/dt): LC v_C″ + RC v_C′ + v_C = v_s.

Substituting v_C = Ae^{st} into the homogeneous equation gives the **characteristic equation** LCs² + RCs + 1 = 0, i.e. s² + (R/L)s + 1/(LC) = 0. The roots depend only on the t > 0 circuit and its parameters, not on the sources or initial values.

For circuits that are neither purely series nor purely parallel (e.g. an inductor feeding R ∥ C), write KCL at the node and KVL around the loop, then eliminate; the coefficients of the characteristic equation come from that step, not from the series formula.

ideas.title: 三种阻尼状态的判定（串联）
text: RLC 串联：比较 R 与临界电阻 2√(L/C)。R > 2√(L/C)：两个不相等的负实根，**过阻尼**（非振荡）；R = 2√(L/C)：二重根，**临界阻尼**；R < 2√(L/C)：一对共轭复根，**欠阻尼**（衰减振荡）；R = 0：纯虚根，等幅振荡。
物理图景：电容储存的电场能与电感储存的磁场能来回交换，电阻每次都消耗一部分。电阻大，能量还没交换就耗完了（不振荡）；电阻小，能量来回振荡多次才衰减完。

en.title: The three damping cases (series circuit)
text: Series RLC: compare R with the critical resistance 2√(L/C). R > 2√(L/C): two distinct negative real roots, **overdamped** (no oscillation); R = 2√(L/C): a double root, **critically damped**; R < 2√(L/C): a complex-conjugate pair, **underdamped** (decaying oscillation); R = 0: imaginary roots, undamped oscillation.

Physically, energy swings between the capacitor's electric field and the inductor's magnetic field, and the resistor takes some of it every time. A large R uses it up before it can swing back (no oscillation); a small R lets it swing many times while decaying.

ideas.title: 特征根、衰减系数 α 与阻尼振荡角频率 ω_d
text: 串联电路中 α = R/(2L)（衰减系数），ω_0 = 1/√(LC)（谐振角频率，无阻尼时的振荡角频率），特征根 s_{1,2} = −α ± √(α² − ω_0²)。
欠阻尼时 s_{1,2} = −α ± jω_d，ω_d = √(ω_0² − α²) 为**阻尼振荡角频率**：响应按 e^{−αt} 衰减，按 ω_d 振荡，振荡周期 T_d = 2π/ω_d。注意 ω_d < ω_0。
过阻尼时两个根都是负实数，|s| 小的那个衰减得慢，决定响应拖多久。

en.title: Roots, attenuation α and damped frequency ω_d
text: In a series circuit α = R/(2L) (attenuation coefficient), ω_0 = 1/√(LC) (resonant, i.e. undamped, angular frequency), and the roots are s_{1,2} = −α ± √(α² − ω_0²).
Underdamped: s_{1,2} = −α ± jω_d, where ω_d = √(ω_0² − α²) is the **damped angular frequency**: the response decays as e^{−αt} and oscillates at ω_d, with period T_d = 2π/ω_d. Note ω_d < ω_0.
Overdamped: both roots are negative reals; the one with the smaller |s| decays more slowly and sets how long the response lasts.

ideas.title: 两个初始条件：0₊ 等效电路与导数
text: 换路定则给出 v_C(0₊) = v_C(0₋)、i_L(0₊) = i_L(0₋)（由 t < 0 的直流稳态求：电容开路、电感短路）。
二阶方程还需要**一阶导数的初始值**。画 0₊ 等效电路：电容换成电压为 v_C(0₊) 的电压源，电感换成电流为 i_L(0₊) 的电流源，解这个电阻电路求 i_C(0₊)、v_L(0₊)，再用 dv_C/dt(0₊) = i_C(0₊)/C、di_L/dt(0₊) = v_L(0₊)/L。
i_C、v_L 一般会跳变，dv_C/dt(0₊) 并不总是零；只有 i_C(0₊) = 0 时才为零。

en.title: Two initial conditions: the 0+ circuit and derivatives
text: The switching rules give v_C(0+) = v_C(0−) and i_L(0+) = i_L(0−) (found from the DC steady state for t < 0: capacitor open, inductor short).

A second-order equation also needs **the initial value of the first derivative**. Draw the 0+ equivalent circuit: replace the capacitor by a voltage source v_C(0+) and the inductor by a current source i_L(0+), solve this resistive circuit for i_C(0+) and v_L(0+), then dv_C/dt(0+) = i_C(0+)/C and di_L/dt(0+) = v_L(0+)/L.
i_C and v_L generally jump, so dv_C/dt(0+) is not always zero — only when i_C(0+) = 0.

ideas.title: 零输入响应的三种形式与定常数
text: 过阻尼：v_C = A_1e^{s_1t} + A_2e^{s_2t}；临界阻尼：v_C = (A_1 + A_2t)e^{−αt}；欠阻尼：v_C = e^{−αt}(A_{1}cos ω_dt + A_{2}sin ω_dt)。
用 v_C(0₊) 和 dv_C/dt(0₊) 两个条件列两个方程解出 A_1、A_2，再由 i = C dv_C/dt（或 v_L = L di/dt）求其他量。
常用结论：串联电路电容放电、i(0₊) = 0、v_C(0₊) = V_0 时，欠阻尼电流 i = \frac{V_0}{ω_dL}e^{−αt}sin ω_dt，第一次过零在 t = π/ω_d；临界阻尼时电流在 t = 1/α 达到最大。

en.title: The three forms of the zero-input response; finding the constants
text: Overdamped: v_C = A_1e^{s_1t} + A_2e^{s_2t}; critically damped: v_C = (A_1 + A_2t)e^{−αt}; underdamped: v_C = e^{−αt}(A_{1}cos ω_dt + A_{2}sin ω_dt).
Two conditions, v_C(0+) and dv_C/dt(0+), give two equations for A_1 and A_2; other quantities follow from i = C dv_C/dt (or v_L = L di/dt).

Useful results for a series capacitor discharge with i(0+) = 0 and v_C(0+) = V_0: underdamped current i = \frac{V_0}{ω_dL}e^{−αt}sin ω_dt, first zero at t = π/ω_d; critically damped current peaks at t = 1/α.

ideas.title: 阶跃响应与全响应：特解 + 齐次解
text: 有激励时，全解 = 特解（换路后的稳态值，直流激励时 v_C(∞)、i_L(∞) 由电容开路、电感短路求）+ 齐次解（形式由特征根决定）。
**先加上特解，再用初始条件定常数**：例如 v_C = v_C(∞) + e^{−αt}(A_{1}cos ω_dt + A_{2}sin ω_dt)，令 t = 0₊ 时等于 v_C(0₊)、导数等于 dv_C/dt(0₊)。
零状态阶跃响应（v_C(0₋) = 0、i_L(0₋) = 0）欠阻尼时会出现**超调**：v_C 在 t = π/ω_d 达到最大，超过终值。三要素法只适用于一阶电路，二阶电路不能套用。

en.title: Step and complete responses: particular + homogeneous
text: With a source, the complete solution = particular solution (the new steady state; for DC, v_C(∞) and i_L(∞) with C open, L short) + homogeneous solution (form set by the roots).
**Add the particular solution first, then fit the constants**: e.g. v_C = v_C(∞) + e^{−αt}(A_{1}cos ω_dt + A_{2}sin ω_dt), matched to v_C(0+) and dv_C/dt(0+) at t = 0+.

An underdamped zero-state step response (v_C(0−) = 0, i_L(0−) = 0) **overshoots**: v_C peaks above its final value at t = π/ω_d. The three-element method is for first-order circuits only; it does not apply here.

ideas.title: GCL 并联电路（对偶）
text: R、L、C 并联，以并联电压 v 或电感电流 i_L 为变量：C dv/dt + v/R + i_L = i_s，v = L di_L/dt，得 LC i_L″ + (L/R)i_L′ + i_L = i_s，特征方程 s² + \frac{1}{RC}s + \frac{1}{LC} = 0。
并联电路 α = 1/(2RC)，ω_0 仍为 1/√(LC)。判据与串联**相反**：R < ½√(L/C)（电导大）过阻尼，R = ½√(L/C) 临界，R > ½√(L/C) 欠阻尼——并联电阻越大，损耗越小，越容易振荡。

en.title: The parallel GCL circuit (the dual)
text: R, L and C in parallel, with the common voltage v or the inductor current i_L as the unknown: C dv/dt + v/R + i_L = i_s, v = L di_L/dt, so LC i_L″ + (L/R)i_L′ + i_L = i_s and the characteristic equation is s² + \frac{1}{RC}s + \frac{1}{LC} = 0.

In the parallel circuit α = 1/(2RC) while ω_0 is still 1/√(LC). The criterion is **reversed** from the series case: R < ½√(L/C) (large conductance) is overdamped, R = ½√(L/C) critical, R > ½√(L/C) underdamped — the larger the parallel R, the smaller the loss and the easier it oscillates.

ideas.title: 含受控源时的等效电阻
text: 回路中串有控制量为回路电流的 CCVS 时，KVL 里它和电阻合并成一个等效电阻 R_eq（例如电压升高 ri 时 R_eq = R − r）。阻尼状态、α 都要用 R_eq 判断，受控源可以把过阻尼变成欠阻尼，R_eq < 0 时甚至振荡发散。
受控源吸收的功率仍按 p = vi（关联参考方向）计算；它“发出”的功率抵消了一部分电阻的损耗。

en.title: Dependent sources: an equivalent resistance
text: A CCVS in the loop controlled by the loop current combines with the resistors in KVL into an equivalent resistance R_eq (e.g. a voltage rise ri gives R_eq = R − r). Judge damping and α with R_eq: a dependent source can turn an overdamped circuit underdamped, and with R_eq < 0 the oscillation even grows.
Its absorbed power is still p = vi (passive sign convention); the power it delivers cancels part of the resistor's loss.

formulas.name: RLC 串联方程
formulas.when: R、L、C 与 v_s 串联，t > 0；回路电流 i 与 v_C 关联（i = C dv_C/dt）。

en.name: Series RLC equation
en.when: R, L, C and v_s in series, t > 0; loop current i and v_C in the passive sign convention (i = C dv_C/dt).

formulas.name: 串联特征根
formulas.when: RLC 串联（含受控源时 R 用等效电阻 R_eq）。

en.name: Series roots
en.when: Series RLC (with a dependent source use the equivalent R_eq).

formulas.name: 阻尼振荡角频率
formulas.when: 仅欠阻尼（α < ω_0）；特征根 −α ± jω_d。

formulas.name: 串联阻尼判据
formulas.expr: R > 2\sqrt{\frac{L}{C}} 过阻尼；R = 2\sqrt{\frac{L}{C}} 临界；R < 2\sqrt{\frac{L}{C}} 欠阻尼
formulas.when: RLC 串联（等价于 α 与 ω_0 比较）；R = 0 时等幅振荡。

en.name: Series damping criterion
en.expr: R > 2\sqrt{\frac{L}{C}} over; R = 2\sqrt{\frac{L}{C}} critical; R < 2\sqrt{\frac{L}{C}} under
en.when: Series RLC (same as comparing α with ω_0); R = 0 gives undamped oscillation.

formulas.name: GCL 并联
formulas.expr: α = \frac{1}{2RC}；R < \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{L}{C}} 过阻尼，R > \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{L}{C}} 欠阻尼
formulas.when: R、L、C 并联；方向与串联判据相反。ω_0 = 1/√(LC) 不变。

en.name: Parallel GCL
en.when: R, L, C in parallel; the opposite way round from the series criterion. ω_0 = 1/√(LC) as before.

formulas.name: 导数初始值
formulas.when: i_C 与 v_C、v_L 与 i_L 均为关联参考方向；i_C(0₊)、v_L(0₊) 由 0₊ 等效电路求。

en.name: Initial derivatives
en.when: i_C with v_C and v_L with i_L in the passive sign convention; get i_C(0+), v_L(0+) from the 0+ equivalent circuit.

formulas.name: 齐次解的形式
formulas.expr: 过阻尼 A_1e^{s_1t} + A_2e^{s_2t}；临界 (A_1 + A_2t)e^{−αt}；欠阻尼 e^{−αt}(A_{1}cos ω_dt + A_{2}sin ω_dt)
formulas.when: 常数 A_1、A_2 由 0₊ 时的函数值和一阶导数确定（有激励时先加上特解）。

en.name: Forms of the homogeneous solution
en.expr: over A_1e^{s_1t} + A_2e^{s_2t}; critical (A_1 + A_2t)e^{−αt}; under e^{−αt}(A_{1}cos ω_dt + A_{2}sin ω_dt)
en.when: A_1, A_2 come from the value and the first derivative at 0+ (add the particular solution first when there is a source).

formulas.name: 欠阻尼放电电流
formulas.when: RLC 串联零输入，v_C(0₊) = V_0、i(0₊) = 0，i 为放电方向（从电容“+”极板流出，i = −C dv_C/dt）。

en.name: Underdamped discharge current
en.when: Zero-input series RLC with v_C(0+) = V_0, i(0+) = 0, i in the discharge direction (out of the capacitor's “+” plate, i = −C dv_C/dt).

formulas.name: 全响应
formulas.when: 直流（阶跃）激励，t > 0；v_C(∞) 为换路后的稳态值（C 开路、L 短路）。

en.name: Complete response
en.when: DC (step) excitation, t > 0; v_C(∞) is the new steady state (C open, L short).

formulas.name: 受控源等效电阻
formulas.when: 回路中的 CCVS 电压沿回路电流方向为升高 ri（控制量就是回路电流）；若为压降则 R_eq = R + r。

en.name: Equivalent resistance with a CCVS
en.when: The CCVS in the loop is a rise ri along the loop current (which is its controlling current); for a drop R_eq = R + r.

examples.title: 电容经 R、L 欠阻尼放电
examples.statement: 图示电路中电容原已充电，v_C(0₋) = 6 V；R = 2 Ω，L = 1 H，C = 0.1 F。t = 0 时 S 闭合。判断阻尼状态，求 α、ω_d、v_L(0₊)，以及 t = π/6 s 时的电流 i 和 t = π/3 s 时的 v_C。
steps: 3. **初始条件。** v_C(0₊) = v_C(0₋) = 6 V，i(0₊) = i_L(0₋) = 0。0₊ 时 R 上无压降，**v_L(0₊) = v_C(0₊) = 6 V**。i 是放电方向（从电容“+”极板流出），与 v_C 非关联：i = −C dv_C/dt，所以 dv_C/dt(0₊) = −i(0₊)/C = 0。

en.title: Underdamped discharge of a capacitor through R and L
en.statement: The capacitor is initially charged, v_C(0−) = 6 V; R = 2 Ω, L = 1 H, C = 0.1 F. S closes at t = 0. Decide the damping, find α, ω_d, v_L(0+), the current i at t = π/6 s and v_C at t = π/3 s.
steps: 3. **Initial conditions.** v_C(0+) = v_C(0−) = 6 V, i(0+) = i_L(0−) = 0. At 0+ there is no drop across R, so **v_L(0+) = v_C(0+) = 6 V**. i is the discharge current (out of the “+” plate), against the passive sign convention for v_C: i = −C dv_C/dt, hence dv_C/dt(0+) = −i(0+)/C = 0.
4. **Constants.** v_C = e^{−t}(A_{1}cos 3t + A_{2}sin 3t). At t = 0: A_1 = 6; derivative: −A_1 + 3A_2 = 0 → A_2 = 2. v_C = e^{−t}(6cos 3t + 2sin 3t) V.
5. **Current.** i = −C dv_C/dt = 2e^{−t}sin 3t A (matching V_0/(ω_dL) = 6/3 = 2). At t = π/6 s, sin 3t = 1: **i = 2e^{−π/6} ≈ 1.185 A**.
6. **At t = π/3 s.** cos 3t = −1, sin 3t = 0: **v_C = −6e^{−π/3} ≈ −2.104 V** — the capacitor has been charged the other way round: that is the oscillation.

examples.title: 临界阻尼的阶跃响应
examples.statement: 图示 RLC 串联电路原来不带电，电压源为 10u(t) V；R = 4 Ω，L = 1 H，C = 0.25 F。求 di/dt(0₊)、v_C(t)，以及 t = 0.5 s 时的 v_C 和 i。

en.title: Critically damped step response
en.statement: The series RLC circuit is initially at rest and driven by 10u(t) V; R = 4 Ω, L = 1 H, C = 0.25 F. Find di/dt(0+), v_C(t), and v_C and i at t = 0.5 s.
steps: 1. **Damping.** 2√(L/C) = 2√4 = 4 = R: **critically damped**; α = R/(2L) = **2 s⁻¹**, double root s = −2.

2. **Initial conditions.** Zero state: v_C(0+) = 0, i(0+) = 0. In the 0+ circuit neither R nor C has any voltage, so **v_L(0+) = 10 V** and di/dt(0+) = v_L(0+)/L = **10 A/s**; dv_C/dt(0+) = i(0+)/C = 0.
3. **Particular solution.** DC steady state, capacitor open: **v_C(∞) = 10 V**.
6. **At t = 0.5 s.** **v_C = 10 − 20e^{−1} ≈ 2.642 V**, **i = 5e^{−1} ≈ 1.839 A**. This is also the peak of i: with critical damping the current peaks at t = 1/α = 0.5 s.

mistakes.text: 把串联判据 R 与 2√(L/C) 比较直接用到 GCL 并联电路上。并联时 α = 1/(2RC)，R 越**小**阻尼越强；最稳妥的办法是写出特征方程看判别式。

en.text: Using the series test (R against 2√(L/C)) on a parallel GCL circuit. In parallel α = 1/(2RC) and a **smaller** R means more damping; the safe way is to write the characteristic equation and look at its discriminant.

mistakes.text: 想当然地取 dv_C/dt(0₊) = 0 或 di_L/dt(0₊) = 0。导数初始值要从 0₊ 等效电路中的 i_C(0₊)、v_L(0₊) 求，只有它们为零时导数才为零。

en.text: Assuming dv_C/dt(0+) = 0 or di_L/dt(0+) = 0. The initial derivatives come from i_C(0+) and v_L(0+) in the 0+ circuit; they are zero only if those are.

mistakes.text: 先用初始条件定齐次解的常数，最后才加上稳态值。必须先写出“特解 + 齐次解”的完整形式，再代入初始条件。

en.text: Fitting the constants of the homogeneous solution first and adding the steady state afterwards. Write the full form “particular + homogeneous” first, then apply the initial conditions.

mistakes.text: 放电电流 i 从电容“+”极板流出时与 v_C 非关联，i = −C dv_C/dt。漏掉负号会使电流整体反号。

en.text: When the discharge current i leaves the capacitor's “+” plate it is against the passive sign convention for v_C: i = −C dv_C/dt. Dropping the minus sign flips the whole current.

mistakes.text: 混淆 ω_d 与 ω_0：振荡的角频率是 ω_d = √(ω_0² − α²)，不是 1/√(LC)；衰减快慢由 α 决定。

en.text: Confusing ω_d with ω_0: the oscillation is at ω_d = √(ω_0² − α²), not 1/√(LC); how fast it decays is set by α.

mistakes.text: 把一阶电路的三要素法套到二阶电路上。二阶响应有两个特征根，没有单一的时间常数。

en.text: Applying the first-order three-element method to a second-order circuit. A second-order response has two roots and no single time constant.
